ourServices.ourServicesMarkdown:
RENOVA delivers full-service countertop installation for any kitchen size, style, or budget in Bellevue. We manage turnkey installs for quartz, granite, porcelain, and butcher block with all features included — from removal to backsplash tile.

### Services Include:

Countertop removal & disposal — safe tear-out, proper disposal, and site protection  
Templating & layout advice — laser or digital template, edge profiles (waterfall, chamfer, ogee), integrated or undermount sink planning  
Fabrication & delivery — slabs cut in our local shop (MSI, Pental, Cambria, local stone mills)  
Installation — seam matching, joint reinforcement, epoxy bonding, backsplash tile (subway or backsplash tile installed as part of scope)  
Countertop repair & refinish — chip repair, seal inspection, stone polishing  
Commercial support — businesses, bars, pantries, or resale-ready install with ADA or performance-grade finishes  
Warranty & maintenance services — instructions, touch-up access, and protective sealants when needed

We handle the entire project with Bellevue trades—no outsourcing installations to strangers. If you’re comparing “kitchen countertop installers Bellevue” or searching “countertop cost Bellevue” our scope clearly lays out options like quartz vs granite vs porcelain or installation upgrades like waterfall edge or walk-in pantry counters.

RENOVA installs designer edge profiles (eased, cove, radius) and coordinates backsplash tile with mortar bed as needed for seamless function. Looking for “countertop backsplash installation Bellevue” or “waterfall edge countertop Bellevue”? We do that clean, with matching seams and integrated sink planning.

manufacturers.h2: Materials & Brands – What We Install in Bellevue Kitchens 🪨
manufacturers.markdownmanufacturers:
We install countertops that hold up — not showroom samples, not prefab pieces. Everything is sourced locally, built for real kitchens, and installed to last.

### Materials We Work With:
- **Quartz** – We install Pental, Cambria, MSI, and Caesarstone slabs — great for clean seams, durability, and modern styles.  
- **Granite** – Every piece is unique. We hand-select slabs for strength and pattern that makes sense in your kitchen.  
- **Porcelain** – For homeowners who want the marble look without the maintenance — strong, clean, and heat-resistant.  
- **Butcher block** – We work with real maple and walnut tops — sealed, leveled, and cut for sinks and cooktops.  
- **Integrated sinks** – If you want a one-piece seamless sink and counter, we handle the layout, cut, and bonding.

Every material we install is cut clean, sealed right, and backed by a solid warranty. We’ll walk you through what holds up, what needs care, and what makes sense for your layout and budget. No guessing. No pressure. Just good work, from start to finish. ✅

howWeWork.howWeWorkMarkdown:
When we install countertops, we don’t guess. Everything’s measured on-site, cut to fit, and installed by the same crew that quoted the job. You’ll know who’s coming, when they’re coming, and what’s happening each step of the way.

### Here’s How It Works:

**Site visit & measurement** – We come to your home, check your cabinets, take real measurements, and talk through your layout and options.  
**Quote with real numbers** – We’ll show you price differences between quartz, granite, butcher block, or porcelain. No fluff — you’ll know exactly what’s included.  
**Template & scheduling** – Once your cabinets are in, we come back to template for the countertop. We work around your timeline, not the other way around.  
**Tear-out & prep** – If you have old countertops, we’ll remove them, check the structure, and prep the space before install.  
**Fabrication** – Your slab is cut, edged, and polished — either in our shop or at one of our local partners.  
**Installation** – We bring it in, seam it tight, level it right, and seal it clean. Sinks, backsplashes, everything.  
**Final walk-through** – You check every corner and seam with us. If something’s off, we fix it before we leave.

We don’t leave behind scraps, silicone blobs, or excuses. Just clean countertops, done right the first time.

faqItems.question: How much does countertop installation cost in Bellevue?
faqItems.answer: Homeowners in Bellevue report quartz countertops between $80–$116 per sq ft, with total kitchen installs averaging $11,000–$14,000 depending on layout and edge details. RENOVA provides a fixed quote after measuring your space. As a local supplier, RENOVA blends slab and labor into one transparent number—no surprises at install.

faqItems.question: Quartz vs. granite: which lasts longer and needs less maintenance?
faqItems.answer: Many Seattle homeowners lean toward quartz because it resists stains and doesn’t need sealing—granite requires sealing every 1–3 years, especially with lighter colors. RENOVA walks homeowners through care requirements and long-term value so you choose what fits your lifestyle.

faqItems.question: Are waterfall-edge countertops still popular?
faqItems.answer: The waterfall edge looked edgy a few years back—but many users now regret it, citing cost, slab waste, and the style feeling dated. RENOVA shows both pros and cons of edge styles so you can decide if that trend fits your square footage and resale goals.

faqItems.question: Should I avoid Home Depot or Ikea countertop installers in Bellevue?
faqItems.answer: Redditors often regret going with national chains due to higher pricing and third-party crews with little accountability. RENOVA provides cabinet, countertop, and plumbing coordination in-house—no handoffs, no surcharge, accountable service from demo to final walkthrough.

faqItems.question: Can you repair or re-polish existing countertops instead of replacing them?
faqItems.answer: Some local Reddit threads report minor countertop damage that was easily repaired instead of replaced—like chips or dulling over time. RENOVA inspects your countertop first. If repair makes sense—like a crack or dull finish—you get that option alongside full replacement.

faqItems.question: What about countertop heat resistance in Bellevue kitchens?
faqItems.answer: Quartz resists stains and scratches but isn’t fully heatproof. Granite can crack if hot pots are placed directly on seams. RENOVA shares best-use tips and installs heat-resistant slabs—ensuring seams and adhesives won’t fail under real-world kitchen use.

faqItems.question: What’s the advantage of using local Bellevue fabricators like RENOVA?
faqItems.answer: Many homeowners say local shops are more responsive and accurate than national chains. RENOVA templates your space after cabinets are installed, orders slabs from local suppliers (Metro Quartz, Dunn), installs with in-house crews, removes old tops, and seals seams properly. You get one point of contact and a warranty-backed job.
